Use actual scene-derived render or licensed authored layers, not a few colored blocks. Keep hidden classification separate.

Verify native source dimensions, decoded pixels, both-eye frame and source/license manifest; do not call an enlarged low-resolution grid high resolution.

gates.acceptance: Same scene/seed produces distinguishable clear, overcast, rain, heavy storm, snow and hail cases and visibly different wind/grime settings; low/medium/high camera settings improve measurable feature resolution without changing scene truth. A clear reference remains available to verification only.
